games.name: Producer Race
games.line: Pick the producer that wins each 6-hour race, four a day (Sunday's races are for fun: All time only). A 2nd or 3rd place finish scores a Show.

board.unranked: To play on the Staked board, stake at least 1 VHP in the Producer Race.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (from Week 1, the week of Mon 16 Nov).

games.name: Daily Questions
games.line: Answer quick questions about block producers, Monday to Saturday. Stake VHP to share the weekly rewards.

games.name: Who Signs Block X
games.line: Pick the producer for the next 12 milestone blocks, about 2 hours apart.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in Block X that week.

free.prize: 1st and 2nd at the end of the week win 2 and 1 VHP (picks on 3 or more days, at least 1 point).

games.name: Survivor
games.line: One producer a day, two lives, four-week seasons. Last one standing wins.

games.name: Fantasy Producers
games.line: Draft 5 producers under a salary cap, with a captain who scores double.

games.name: Block Golf
games.line: Every Knode Games game is a hole: your place on each game's weekly board sets your strokes. Nothing to pick; lowest score wins.

board.unranked: To be on the Staked board, stake in Block Golf this week (at least the vault's minimum, 1 VHP today).

free.prize: The Free play board pays no VHP prize for now. Players staked in Block Golf share its weekly bucket.

games.name: Producer Bracket
games.line: A weekly knockout of block producers, head to head: one round a day, the final on Saturday. Pick every winner by Monday night.

board.unranked: The Staked board is for wallets with at least 1 VHP staked in the Producer Bracket that week.

free.prize: Weekly prize with at least 1 point: tied for 1st share all 3 VHP; otherwise 2 VHP to 1st and 1 VHP shared by those tied 2nd.
